svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Central in the middle. The customer browser calls Central. Central calls Atlas in each region for VMs, images, IPs, snapshots and console, and Atlas sends signed VM state webhooks back. Central calls Cargo to create buckets and rotate keys, and Cargo sends a webhook when a cluster is usable. Central writes site and domain routes to the HTTP proxy cluster. Central calls Pilot for login, rename and admin domain, and Pilot enrolls, sends heartbeats and registers domains with Central.
